water_source.citation: IAPWS R11-24, Revised Release on the Ionization Constant of H2O (2024).
water_source.locator: p. 2 nomenclature; p. 3 Eq. (1) and activity standards; p. 6 Table 3, 50 C, psat row with footnote b (liquid at 0.1 MPa below 100 C).
water_source.basis: Ion molality standard m0=1 mol/kg, pure-liquid water activity. Source is 2 H2O <-> H3O+ + OH-. Formal H+ := H3O+ - H2O gives H2O <-> H+ + OH- and a_H3O=a_H*a_water, retaining Kw and one explicit water activity. Adopted formal-species convention; no hydronium parameters substituted.
water_source.rounding: pKw is the published table value, rounded to 0.01; no falsely precise recomputation.
